images.name: Lighthouse
images.subsector: Commercial and industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage
images.description: Lighthouse is a portfolio of 38 operating commercial-and-industrial distributed solar and solar-plus-storage projects totaling 89 MWDC across California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont and Washington. The portfolio is asset-heavy and contracted, with operating renewable-generation and storage assets serving long-term commercial and industrial offtakers. BlackRock's Evergreen infrastructure strategy signed to acquire Lighthouse in November 2023 and the sale closed in December 2023. Excelsior Energy Capital sold 100% of its membership interests in the portfolio through Excelsior Renewable Energy Investment Fund I LP and disclosed the completed exit in March 2024. The transaction disclosure does not establish that BlackRock owns 100% of every project's total economic interests, so the current platform-level percentage is not inferred. Lighthouse is counted once as the manager-level portfolio; its 38 underlying project and SPV assets are not separate PortCos. No later portfolio sale, transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
